m:
From: Chase Fraud Alert <alerts@chase-secure-verify.example>
We detected a $2,340 purchase. If this wasn't you, reply with your card number and PIN to cancel it.
why: Banks never ask for your PIN, and the sender's address isn't the bank's real domain. Call the number on the back of your card instead.

m: Your dentist appointment is confirmed for Tue 11/17 at 2:30 PM. Reply C to confirm or call our office to reschedule.
why: No link, no payment, no pressure, and it sends you to an office you already know. If you're unsure, call the office directly.

m: Mom it's me, I broke my phone and this is a friend's number. I'm stuck and need $800 for a repair, can you Zelle it now? Please don't call, I can't talk.
why: A new number, urgency, a payment app, and a request not to call are the classic family-emergency setup. Call your child on their usual number first.

m: USPS: Your package is on hold due to an incomplete address. Update within 12 hours or it will be returned: usps-redelivery.example/track
why: USPS texts only people who asked for tracking updates, and even those texts never include a link. The web address isn't usps.com either.

m: Your Amazon order #113-4471205 has shipped. Track it any time in Your Orders in the Amazon app.
why: It doesn't ask you to click anything or pay anything, and it points you to the app you already use. Checking there is always safe.

m: This is the IRS. A lawsuit has been filed against you for unpaid taxes. Call 202-555-0143 immediately or a warrant will be issued for your arrest.
why: The IRS normally contacts you by mail first and doesn't threaten arrest by phone or text.

m: Hi, this is Dana from Dr. Patel's office. Your lab results are in your patient portal. Log in the usual way to view them.
why: It tells you to log in the way you normally do instead of giving you a link. That's what a careful office does.

m: Congratulations! You've been selected for a $1,000 Costco reward. Just pay $4.95 shipping to claim: costco-rewards.example
why: A prize that costs money to claim is a scam, and the address isn't Costco's real site.

m: Microsoft Security: Your computer is infected with 3 viruses. Do not shut down. Call Microsoft Support at 312-555-0199 now.
why: Microsoft doesn't put phone numbers in pop-up warnings. Close the browser; if it won't close, restart the computer.
